name: Law of Past Experience
axiom: People read an ambiguous mark by the conventions they already carry.
trigger: A green button deletes an account, or a back arrow sits on the right of the row.

checklist.text: Keep red for destructive, green for success, and amber for caution, because users already do.
Use a cart for the basket, a gear for settings, a speech bubble for comments.
Put forward on the right and back on the left in left-to-right locales.
Test an icon without its label; a wrong guess marks a convention the user does not share.

antiPattern.violation: A green button deletes an account, and the undo prompt is the first time anyone is told.
antiPattern.remediation: Destructive actions are red and named; success is green and never destroys.
